newsitem.title: THAILAND: IMF chief to visit Thailand next week - ministry.
newsitem.headline: IMF chief to visit Thailand next week - ministry.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Michel Camdessus will visit Thailand on December 10 at the invitation of Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan, a ministry official said on Wednesday.
"The finance minister had invited the IMF head to visit Thailand on December 10 during his trip to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) meeting in Singapore next week," the official told Reuters.
Camdessus would have talks with Amnuay and was also expected to meet new Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh.

Thailand's economy has slowed down this year after nearly a decade of nearly nine percent gross domestic product growth and economic revival was one of Chavalit's major planks during his election campaign.
